name: V60 Pour Over
summary: A clean, bright cup made with a conical dripper and paper filter. Rewards precision on pour timing and water flow.

steps.title: Rinse the filter
steps.instruction: Place the filter in the dripper and rinse it with hot water to remove paper taste and preheat the vessel. Discard the rinse water.
steps.tip: A cold dripper pulls heat from your brew, so preheating matters.

steps.title: Add coffee and level
steps.instruction: Add 22g of freshly ground coffee to the filter. Gently shake the dripper to level the bed, then zero your scale.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.instruction: Pour about 45g of water evenly over the grounds in a spiral, starting from the center. Let it sit and degas.
steps.tip: You should see bubbling — that's CO2 escaping fresh coffee.

steps.title: First pour
steps.instruction: Pour in slow spirals up to 150g total, avoiding the very edge of the filter.

steps.title: Second pour
steps.instruction: Continue pouring in spirals up to 250g total, keeping the water level fairly steady.

steps.title: Final pour
steps.instruction: Pour the remainder up to 360g total, then let the bed drain fully.

steps.title: Drawdown
steps.instruction: Let the water fully drain through the bed. Swirl the server gently before serving.
steps.tip: Total brew time of 2:30–3:30 is typical; adjust grind size if it runs faster or slower.
